description: Get the Lowdown on a person from the numbrU engine. Call with depth "card" first (the default): it returns a short card with KNOW, AVOID, and INSTEAD. If the user has described the moment (a listing meeting, a negotiation, a first call), pass it in context so the card fits that moment. When the user asks to go deeper, call again with the same name, dob, vertical, and context and depth "full" for the Deeper Details: how they decide, what earns their trust, the signs to watch for, and how to communicate. IMPORTANT: present the returned output verbatim, exactly as formatted, preserving every heading. Do not summarize, reword, reorder, condense into tables, or describe the sections instead of showing them. The formatting is the product. Get every read from generate_compass only: do not call create_person, list_people, or get_person to get or deepen a read, and do not save the person unless the user asks. In any note you add after the output, refer to the person by first name or "they", never he/she.

context.description: Optional: the moment the user described, in their words (e.g. 'listing appointment Thursday, first meeting').

depth.description: card = short card first (default). full = Deeper Details, only when the user asks to go deeper.

dob.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format (optional). If not provided, proceed with name only.
